    {
      "name": "EarlyON Child and Family Centre - Acton & Georgetown (Links2Care)",

      "source_name": "Links2Care EarlyON"
    }

Notes on what I could and couldn't confirm:

- 
Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's fall rec program begins September 12th, with registration having begun July 20th
. Their site lists a 
Kindergym program for 18 months - 3.11 yrs, for the toddler who loves to be on the move
, but the specific fall day/time and price for that class weren't printed on the pages I could read — worth a call to confirm.
- 
Links2Care runs in-person EarlyON programs for parents and caregivers to participate in together with their child at locations including the Georgetown EarlyON Centre and Acton EarlyON Centre
, and 
these EarlyON Centres offer free, high-quality programs for families and children from prenatal to 6 years old, where you can learn and play with your child
. No specific fall schedule was posted in what I found — I'd suggest calling ahead for current drop-in times.
